Dans le cadre du développement de produits électroniques intégrés, visant à réduire le nombre de microcontrôleurs et à optimiser les composants, l'Ingénieur Système / Architecte intervient sur l'ensemble du processus de conception des systèmes.
Il contribue à définir l'architecture globale, depuis les choix stratégiques jusqu'à la conception détaillée, en collaboration avec les équipes Hardware (HW) et Software (SW), afin de garantir une solution technique complète et cohérente.
Le poste nécessite une bonne maîtrise des architectures BMS, DCDC et OBC (On-Board Charger), ainsi que des technologies et solutions associées.
 Missions Et Responsabilités Principales
 Analyser les spécifications et exigences clients.
 Élaborer les exigences techniques et les spécifications système (Black Box Requirements).
 Définir les concepts et les architectures système.
 Concevoir les architectures physiques et logiques.
 Détailler et finaliser l'architecture en lien avec les équipes Hardware.
 Définir les algorithmes Software.
 Réaliser les spécifications fonctionnelles sous MBSE avec Simulink.
 Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Hardware et Software pour assurer la cohérence et l'intégration des solutions techniques.
 Livrables Attendus
 Analyse des spécifications.
 Spécifications des exigences fonctionnelles et techniques (Black Box).
 Définition des concepts architecturaux.
 Architectures physiques et logiques.
 Architecture détaillée finalisée avec le Hardware.
 Algorithmes Software.
 Spécifications fonctionnelles réalisées sous MBSE / Simulink.
 Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'ingénieur ou Bac +5en électronique et systèmes embarqués, vous avez au moins 5 ans expérience sur le même type de poste.
 Expertises Métier
 Battery Management Systems (BMS).
 DC/DC Converters (DCDC).
 On-Board Chargers (OBC).
 Battery Charging & Batteries.
 Architectures de systèmes électroniques embarqués.
 Outils Et Méthodologies
 CATIA Magic.
 MBSE (Model-Based Systems Engineering).
 SimScape.
 MATLAB / Simulink.
 SEGULA Technologies is a global engineering group, boosting the competitiveness of all major industrial sectors: automotive, aerospace, energy, rail, naval, life sciences, and telecoms. With a presence in more than 30 countries and 140 locations worldwide, the Group prioritizes close relationships with its clients, driven by the expertise of its 15,000 employees. As a leading engineering player putting innovation at the heart of its strategy, SEGULA Technologies manages large-scale projects, ranging from initial studies to industrialization and production. SEGULA TECHNOLOGIES is dedicated to gender balance and diversity, recognizing and recruiting talent of all backgrounds.

items.jobTitle: Junior Engine Control System & Monitoring Engineer
items.jobDescription: The Exploration Company entwickelt und betreibt Raumfahrzeuge sowie eigene Raketentriebwerke für Orbitalflüge. Gesucht wird ein Junior Engine Control System & Monitoring Engineer (m/w/d) zur Entwicklung und Validierung von Regelungs- und Überwachungsalgorithmen für den Storm-Triebwerk. Ein Master-Abschluss in Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik, Elektrotechnik, Regelungstechnik oder verwandten Disziplinen, fundierte Kenntnisse in Regelungstheorie sowie praktische Erfahrung mit MATLAB/Simulink und Python werden vorausgesetzt.

Koordination & Entwicklung
Als Testingenieur ECU-Testing & HiL (m/w/d) übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Absicherung und Validierung elektronischer Steuergeräte und mechatronischer Systeme von Maschinen bei einem renommierten Industrieunternehmen im Raum Paderborn..
An der Schnittstelle zwischen Software, Elektronik, Mechanik und Hydraulik sorgst Du dafür, dass komplexe Funktionen zuverlässig zusammenspielen und die Produkte höchsten Qualitätsansprüchen gerecht werden
Die Position ist ab sofort in Vollzeit - zunächst im Rahmen der Arbeitnehmerüberlassung - zu besetzen. Nutze die Möglichkeit zum Einstieg in ein renommiertes, international agierendes Unternehmen!
Deine Aufgaben als Testingenieur ECU-Testing & HiL (m/w/d)
 • Du planst, spezifizierst und führst Funktions-, Integrations- und Systemtests für elektronische Steuergeräte (ECUs) durch.
 • Du erstellst, automatisierst und pflegst Testfälle und Testsequenzen mit ECU-TEST (tracetronic) sowie Vector CANoe und vTESTstudio.
 • Du konfigurierst, nimmst Hardware-in-the-Loop-Testsysteme in Betrieb und entwickelst diese auf Basis der dSPACE-Toolchain (ControlDesk, ConfigurationDesk) weiter.
 • Du untersuchst Steuergerätekommunikation und Systemverhalten, reproduzierst Fehler und unterstützt bei der systematischen Ursachenanalyse, insbesondere im Bereich Antrieb, Getriebe und mechatronische Systeme.
 • Du bewertest und dokumentierst Testergebnisse, verfolgst Abweichungen nach und entwickelst unsere Testmethoden sowie die Testinfrastruktur kontinuierlich weiter.
Das bringst Du mit
 • Du hast ein Studium der Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Fahrzeugtechnik, des Maschinenbaus oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung abgeschlossen.
 • Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse im ECU-Testing und in der Validierung mechatronischer Systeme mit, idealerweise ergänzt durch eine ISTQB-Zertifizierung.
 • Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit ECU-TEST, dSPACE (ControlDesk, ConfigurationDesk, idealerweise SCALEXIO) sowie Vector CANoe und vTESTstudio.
 • Du kennst Dich mit Steuergerätekommunikation (CAN), Antriebs- und Getriebesystemen aus. Kenntnisse in Python, CAPL und MATLAB/Simulink sind von Vorteil.
 • Du arbeitest analytisch, strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich, verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit CI/CT, Requirements Engineering (z. B. Azure DevOps) oder in der Entwicklung und Validierung von Landmaschinen, Nutzfahrzeugen oder Automotive-Systemen.
Das erwartet Dich
 • Langfristige Perspektive in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen
 • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 35h-Woche
 • Möglichkeit zum anteiligen Homeoffice
 • Weihnachts- und Urlaubsgeld
 • Mitarbeiterrabatte bei Top-Marken (ua. Sky, Adidas, Apple, weg.de)
Bei dieser Position ist zunächst ein Gehaltsrahmen bis zu 65000€ / Jahr, je nach Qualifikation und Erfahrung, vorgesehen.
Übernehme Verantwortung für die Absicherung und Validierung elektronischer Steuergeräte und mechatronischer Systeme! Wir freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung als Testingenieur ECU-Testing & HiL (m/w/d) im Raum Paderborn!
Über uns
Spezialisiert auf die Vermittlung von technischen Fach- und Führungskräften ist die Gecad GmbH als Ingenieurdienstleiter ein Teil der Piening Unternehmensgruppe, einem führenden Unternehmen aus dem Dienstleistungssektor. Unsere Gruppe besteht aus mehreren spezialisierten Tochterunternehmen, die zusammenarbeiten, um innovative Lösungen und erstklassigen Service zu bieten. Mit der Piening Gruppe als Arbeitgeber profitierst Du von allen Ressourcen und Vorteilen unserer Unternehmensgruppe.

items.jobTitle: Expert - Medium Voltage Power Conversion Systems
items.jobDescription:
Huawei Heisenberg Research Center (Munich) is responsible for advanced technology research, architectural development, design and strategic engineering of our products.
 Huawei Ohm Research Center (Nuremberg) is responsible for Advanced Technology Research, Architecture Evolution Design and Strategic Technology Planning.
 Huawei Digital Power is a business unit within Huawei that provides Enterprise & Industry customers, products and solutions like clean power generation, transportation electrification, site power facilities, data center facilities, and embedded power. Huawei Digital Power is committed to integrate Digital and Power Electronics technologies to provide customers with high-quality, energy-efficient, green, and low-carbon power electronics products, facilitating their business success
 The Power Conversion Technology Laboratory within Huawei’s Ohms Research Center in Nuremberg is responsible for Advanced Digital Power Technology Research, Architecture Evolution Design and Strategic Technology Planning, and plays an important role in the Huawei Digital Power business in the design and development of power converters and control systems for applications such as PV Solar & Battery Energy Storage Field, Data Centers, Electric Vehicle, and Embedded Power Supply.
Join us as an:
 Expert - Medium Voltage Power Conversion Systems (m/f/d)
 to contribute to the development of our Huawei Power Conversion Technology Laboratory, which plays an important role in designs and develops power converters and control systems for applications such as Photo Voltaic (PV), Data Center and Critical Power (DCCP), Electric Vehicle (EV), Board Mounted Power Supply (BMP) power ranges from several Watts to Mega Watts, and the most challenging things are high efficiency high density, cost effective and low static power consumption.
 Your mission
 You will be the technical authority in formulating requirements for R&D activities for Medium Voltage Power Conversion Systems
 You will lead and execute the research and development of novel next generation MV architectures and converter structures for high power Solar PV, BESS, Data Center and EV charging applications
 You will take ownership of the design, subsequent verification and validation of MV converter concepts in the R&D laboratories
 You will closely collaborate with external R&D Institutes and Universities in developing novel converter and control algorithms for MV power electronic applications relevant to Huawei Digital Power
 You will generate novel ideas and protect them with IPR fillings
 You will lead and mentor cross discipline R&D Engineers
 Your areas of expertise :
 You hold a PhD or Master's degree in the field of power electronics, electrical and electronic engineering or in a similar engineering discipline
 You shall possess several years of proven experience in Medium Voltage, high power electronics and system experience in product design or prototype development in an industrial context
 You have a deep expertise in MV power electronic converter topologies, modulation, control and algorithm development, more focusing on system and Megawatt level power hardware design
 You have a good working knowledge of MV standards and practical insulation coordination experience is desirable
 You have a proven experience with new technology development initiatives, innovation and technical leadership
 High level of self-reliance and an autonomous target-oriented work style, “can do” attitude, eager to learn new things and ready to think outside the box
 You may have occasional travel related to ongoing projects, seminars, conferences etc.
 You are fluent in written and spoken English, willing to learn German or additional languages are a plus
 By applying to this position, you agree with our Recruitment Privacy Statement. You can read in full our privacy policy here.
 Your rewards of working here
 Our culture is characterized by innovative power and team spirit as well as the intensive exchange of knowledge and experience within our global network.
 To keep your development ongoing, you will find a broad range of training opportunities. Many online and face-to-face training programs incl. language courses in German and Mandarin.
 Our diverse and welcoming environment is shaped by different backgrounds and around 40 individual nationalities.
 Self-responsible work in a competent, motivated and constantly growing team.
 Please send your application and CV (incl. cover letter and reference letters) in English.
 Huawei is a leading global information and communications technology (ICT) solutions provider. Our ICT solutions, products and services are used in more than 170 countries and regions, serving over one-third of the world's population. With 208,000 employees, Huawei is committed to develop the future information society and build a Better Connected World.

Don’t just go to work; become part of a unique company within a fast-moving industry. TOYOTA RACING – creating excitement through team spirit and advanced technology!
We are looking for an Engineer (m/f/d) CFD Simulation specializing in 1D CFD-Simulations to support vehicle development projects at our Cologne headquarters.
Are you a team player who thrives on responsibility, with strong analytical and technical skills? Then you are the right person to take on this challenge. Experience teamwork and be inspired by the passion of our 500-strong workforce for motorsport and automotive projects.
## What we offer:
- exciting projects and a place for technical freedom and innovation to get things moving
- attractive benefits packages e.g. competitive remuneration, social benefits, 30 days annual holiday, car leasing, free on-site gym
- a challenging, fulfilling workplace in a multi-national company within a familiar atmosphere - driven by fascination and passion
## Job description / Tasks:
- conduct 0D/1D CFD simulations, manly for ICE simulation and mating parts, for conventional and alternative-fuel power trains
- ICE Performance development and engine real time model development
- collaboration with universities and other leading external research institutions to drive state-of-the-art development and innovation
- strong emphasis on personal responsibility and self-directed work
## The successful candidate will:
- hold a master’s degree or equivalent in Engineering
- have already basic experience 0D/1D CFD-Simulation within a professional environment in vehicle development
- be proficient with software tools as GTPower and MATLAB/Simulink
- have knowledge and experience with future energy carriers such as e-fuels and hydrogen
- possess a good working knowledge of Catia V5, Cantera, and Python
- be able to speak and write professional English
- show interest in working in an international team and demonstrate intercultural competence, with an affinity for Japanese culture
- be a true team player, accustomed to working in a structured, thorough, and self-organized manner

Das sind Ihre Aufgaben:
 Sie erstellen Simulationsmodelle und entwickeln Algorithmen zur Lenkung, Navigation und Regelung (GNC) von Flugkörpern und Lenkmunition.
 Schwerpunkt Ihrer Arbeit ist die Synthese und Analyse performanter und robuster Flugregler mit klassischen und modernen regelungstechnischen Methoden.
 Hierfür wenden Sie neben robusten linearen Regelungsverfahren wie H∞- und LPV-Regelung auch nichtlineare Verfahren wie Sliding Mode Regelung an.
 Nach Auslegung der GNC-Algorithmen in MATLAB/Simulink unterstützen Sie bei der operationellen Implementierung der Algorithmen.
 Sie wirken bei der Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung von Schusskampagnen im In- und Ausland mit.
 Zudem gehört das Erstellen von Konzepten, Spezifikationen und Dokumentationen zu Ihren Aufgaben.
 Das bringen Sie mit:
 Ihr Studium (Master/Diplom) der technischen Kybernetik, Elektrotechnik oder Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik mit Vertiefung Regelungstechnik haben Sie erfolgreich absolviert und bringen erste Berufserfahrung oder eine abgeschlossene Promotion mit.
 Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse in der Systemdynamik, Regelungs- und Simulationstechnik sowie Flugmechanik.
 Sie haben sehr gute Kenntnisse in MATLAB/Simulink und Grundkenntnisse in Git und C/C++.
 Sichere MS Office- sowie Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse setzen wir voraus.
 Zudem sind Sie flexibel, zielorientiert und kommunikativ und suchen konstant neue technische Herausforderungen.
 Hinweis: Bewerber (m/w/d) mit einer Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt behandelt. Sollten Sie das wünschen, geben Sie bitte dazu – auf freiwilliger Basis – Ihren SB-Status bei Ihrer Bewerbung an.

items.jobTitle: Studienarbeit: ML-basierte selbstlernende Regelung für das Drückwalzen metastabiler Austenite
items.jobDescription:
Wie das Engineering der Zukunft aussieht, erforschen wir am Fraunhofer IEM in Paderborn – gemeinsam mit starken Partnern und viel Leidenschaft für Technik. Unsere Teams entwickeln Lösungen, die wirklich in die Anwendung kommen: von smarten Produkten über vernetzte Produktionssysteme bis hin zu digitalen Services und moderner Software. Dabei denken wir Innovation vom ersten Konzept bis zur Umsetzung. Und genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel!
 Im Rahmen eines DFG-geförderten Forschungsprojektes wurde eine Eigenschaftsregelung für den Umformprozess des Drückwalzens metastabiler Austenite entwickelt. Mit dieser Regelung lassen sich die magnetischen Eigenschaften eines Bauteils im Sinne eines unsichtbaren magnetischen Bar- oder QR-Codes direkt einstellen. Allerdings erfolgt die Parametrierung der Regelung bislang mittels des modellbasierten Entwurfes, wobei für die Modellerstellung zunächst eine Vielzahl an experimentellen Versuchen durchgeführt werden müssen. Hier könnte eine neue ML-basierte, selbstlernende Regelung Abhilfe schaffen, die in dieser Arbeit von Dir entwickelt werden soll. Hierzu sind folgende Teilaufgaben zu bearbeiten:    
 Hier sorgst Du für Veränderung 
 Literaturrecherche und Einarbeitung zur ML-basierten, selbstlernenden Regelung
 Entwicklung einer selbstlernenden Regelung für das Drückwalzen metastabiler Austenite
 Validierung und Analyse der Ergebnisse inkl. Vergleich mit dem bisherigen, modellbasiert entworfenen Regelungsansatz  
 Hiermit bringst Du Dich ein 
 Du studierst aktuell Maschinenbau, Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang an einer Hochschule im Raum Ostwestfalen-Lippe (z.B. Paderborn, Bielefeld, etc.).
 Du hast Kenntnisse in MATLAB o. MATLAB/Simulink und planst diese zu Vertiefen.
 Deine analytische Denkweise, die strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise und eine hohe Proaktivität zeichnen Dich und Deine Arbeit aus.
 Du verfügst über sichere Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, mit denen du komplexe Inhalte klar und verständlich kommunizieren kannst.
 Was wir für Dich bereithalten 
 Du erhältst spannende Einblicke in aktuelle Forschungsprojekte mit hoher gesellschaftlicher Relevanz im Bereich Automatisierung und lernst, wie wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse in die Praxis umgesetzt werden.
 Dich erwartet ein interdisziplinäres und engagiertes Team, in dem Eigeninitiative geschätzt und dir viel Gestaltungsspielraum geboten wird.
 Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten kannst du deine Tätigkeit optimal mit deinem Studium vereinbaren und wertvolle Praxiserfahrungen sammeln.
 Du hast die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen und an der Schnittstelle zwischen Forschung und Industrie aktiv mitzuwirken.
 Bei dieser Position handelt es sich um eine unbezahlte Tätigkeit.
 Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt. Unsere Aufgaben sind vielfältig und anpassbar – für Bewerber*innen mit Behinderung finden wir gemeinsam Lösungen, die ihre Fähigkeiten optimal fördern. 
 Mit ihrer Fokussierung auf zukunftsrelevante Schlüsseltechnologien sowie auf die Verwertung der Ergebnisse in Wirtschaft und Industrie spielt die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft eine zentrale Rolle im Innovationsprozess. Als Wegweiser und Impulsgeber für innovative Entwicklungen und wissenschaftliche Exzellenz wirkt sie mit an der Gestaltung unserer Gesellschaft und unserer Zukunft.  
 Bereit für Veränderung? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt, und mach einen Unterschied! Nach Eingang Deiner Online-Bewerbung erhältst Du eine automatische Empfangsbestätigung. Dann melden wir uns schnellstmöglich und sagen Dir, wie es weitergeht.   
   Noch unentschlossen oder Fragen im Kopf? 
 Fachliche Fragen beantwortet Dir gerne:                 Organisatorisches: 
 Herr Lukas Kersting                                                      Herr Fatih Ufuk

About Alta Ares
Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.
 Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
 Founded in 2024, we have grown to 160 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.
 Role & Mission
 Own the development of FPGA functions for our electronic warfare and signals intelligence capabilities, from initial architecture to validation on operational hardware.
 Work with systems and algorithm engineers to define processing requirements and assess implementation feasibility.
 Build RTL modules in VHDL or SystemVerilog to process digitized RF signals, extract relevant information, and generate waveforms.
 Adapt and validate DSP algorithms for FPGA implementation, balancing numerical accuracy, processing speed, and hardware resources.
 Integrate acquisition and processing chains, including digital down-conversion, filtering, channelization, FFT, detection, direction-finding, and classification.
 Establish verification methods and testbenches to check functional behavior and performance throughout development.
 Connect programmable logic to RF converters and embedded processors, defining data transfers, control interfaces, clocking, and synchronization.
 Resolve implementation constraints, achieve timing closure, and optimize resource utilization and power consumption.
 Bring up FPGA designs on target boards, investigate integration issues, and correlate measured behavior with simulation results.
 Contribute to laboratory and field testing alongside RF, software, and systems engineers.
 Maintain clear design records, interface specifications, and validation evidence.
 Improve reusable FPGA components and development practices as the product portfolio grows.
 Candidate Profile
 MSc in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Signal Processing, or a related field.
 Strong experience developing and verifying RTL in VHDL or SystemVerilog, with a focus on digital signal processing.
 Practical experience implementing designs on SoC FPGAs, including synthesis, implementation, timing analysis, and hardware debugging.
 Strong understanding of sampled signals, frequency conversion, digital filtering, spectral analysis, and fixed-point numerical behavior.
 Ability to reason across FPGA, processor, and RF hardware boundaries when making design decisions.
 Experience modelling algorithms and comparing reference models with hardware results; familiarity with MATLAB, Simulink, Python, or HLS is a plus.
 Familiarity with RF measurements and laboratory equipment, including spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and oscilloscopes, is a plus.
 Prior experience in electronic warfare is welcome but not required.
Skills & Qualities
 Hands-on engineer who enjoys taking designs from simulation to working hardware.
 Methodical approach to debugging, with the ability to isolate problems across complex signal chains.
 Able to own a technical scope independently and communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly.
 Rigorous approach to verification, documentation, and design traceability.
 Comfortable collaborating across disciplines and adapting to evolving product requirements.
 Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-growing company.
 High integrity and professionalism in handling sensitive defense technologies.

Bei Brunel haben Sie die Möglichkeit, sich in anspruchsvollen Entwicklungsprojekten kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, und das branchenübergreifend. ### Ihre Qualifikationen

- Erste oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer elektronischer Systeme - idealerweise in stark regulierten Hochtechnologie-Branchen (z. B. Luft- und Raumfahrt, Automotive oder Medizintechnik)
- Sicherer Umgang mit Simulations- und Modellierungstools, vorzugsweise MATLAB/Simulink
- Kenntnisse im Requirements-Management sowie idealerweise Erfahrung mit normengeführten Entwicklungsprozessen, Inbetriebnahme, Fehleranalyse und Messtechnik
- Erfahrung in der Elektronikentwicklung auf Hardware- oder Softwareebene von Vorteil
- Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
### Ihre Vorteile
- Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
- Hauseigener ver.di-Tarifvertrag
- Jahressonderzahlung

# Ihre Aufgaben
Sie möchten weiterhin selbst entwickeln und zugleich ein kleines Team fachlich voranbringen?
Wir suchen eine erfahrene, praxisorientierte Persönlichkeit für die aktive Entwicklung von AC/DC- und DC/DC-Schaltnetzteilen – von der Spezifikation bis zur Serieneinführung. Ergänzend übernehmen Sie die fachliche und organisatorische Leitung unseres vierköpfigen Entwicklungsteams – ohne disziplinarische Personalverantwortung.
- Eigenständige End-to-End-Entwicklung von AC/DC- und DC/DC-Schaltnetzteilen – von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zur Serieneinführung.
- Auswahl geeigneter Topologien, Definition der Systemarchitektur und Gesamtauslegung von Leistungsstufen, magnetischen Bauteilen, Gate-Treibern, Regelkreisen und Schutzkonzepten.
- Erstellung, Review und technische Freigabe von Schaltplänen im e-CAD-System sowie Verantwortung für ein EMV- und thermisch gerechtes PCB-Design.
- Inbetriebnahme, Messung, Verifikation und Optimierung von Prototypen.
- Berücksichtigung von Sicherheits-, EMV- und Zulassungsanforderungen; Vorbereitung, Begleitung und Bewertung relevanter Prüfungen.
- Technische Begleitung der Validierung und Serieneinführung einschließlich Design-Reviews und Freigaben.
- Fachliche Leitung eines vierköpfigen Entwicklungsteams sowie organisatorische Steuerung von Aufgaben, Prioritäten und Terminen.
- Transparente Planung von Entwicklungskapazitäten und Verfolgung von Projektfortschritt, technischen Risiken und offenen Punkten.
- Moderation technischer Abstimmungen und Design-Reviews sowie Unterstützung bei anspruchsvollen Entwicklungsfragen.
- Mentoring, Wissenstransfer und Förderung einer konstruktiven Zusammenarbeit im Team.
- Abstimmung mit angrenzenden Bereichen, insbesondere Produktmanagement, Produktion und Qualitätssicherung.
# Ihr Profil
- Abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik, Leistungselektronik oder elektronischer Systeme.
- Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Schaltnetzteilen bzw. leistungselektronischen Systemen.
- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Leistungselektronik, Regelungstechnik und analoger Schaltungstechnik.
- Tiefes Verständnis für EMV-gerechtes PCB-Design, thermische Auslegung und die praktische Verifikation von Hardware.
- Erfahrung mit Normenprüfungen und Zertifizierungsprozessen von Vorteil; Kenntnisse in Embedded-Programmierung (C/C++, Mikrocontroller) wünschenswert.
- Freude an fachlicher Anleitung und Mentoring; Fähigkeit, ein kleines Team strukturiert zu koordinieren und Entscheidungen klar zu kommunizieren.
- Analytische, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Hands-on-Mentalität.

# Wir bieten Ihnen
- Eine vielseitige Tätigkeit mit langfristiger Perspektive in einem innovativen, international tätigen und unabhängigen Familienunternehmen, welches ausgezeichnet auf dem Markt positioniert ist.
- Eine herausfordernde Aufgabe, auf die wir Sie mit einer gezielten Einarbeitung vorbereiten.
- Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld in einem dynamischen Team sowie spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
- Eine leistungsgerechte Vergütung, attraktive Sozialleistungen und familienfreundliche, flexible Arbeitszeiten.
- Attraktive Vergünstigungen, Einkaufsvorteile und Corporate Benefits.
- Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege, klare Verantwortlichkeiten und den Freiraum zu eigenem Handeln sowie die Möglichkeit zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.

Who We Are
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams, and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
 The role
 You will build and validate flight dynamics models for Helsing's aerial platforms. The work runs from first principles, through numerical simulation and test campaigns, to validation against flight-test data. These models feed directly into control law design, simulation environments and autonomy development, so their accuracy sets how quickly and safely new capabilities reach the air. You will work in a small team alongside control, aerodynamics and test engineers, specify the experiments needed to verify each model, and report the results to internal teams and external partners.
 The day-to-day
 Develop flight dynamics models for aerial platforms end to end, from model architecture and specification through to validation against flight-test data 
 Specify and run numerical and experimental campaigns, and set the acceptance criteria that decide when a model is fit for use in simulation and control design 
 Work with the control, aerodynamics and test teams so that models feed directly into control law design, simulation environments and autonomy development 
 Attend and analyse flight tests, turning telemetry and anomalies into measurable gains in model fidelity 
 Document and present model assumptions, limitations and validation results so that programme decisions rest on evidence 
 You should apply if you
 Have built and validated flight dynamics models from first principles, and tested them against real flight or experimental data 
 Bring a thorough grounding in aerodynamics, stability and control, and systems modelling, gained through an engineering degree or equivalent practice 
 Work fluently in Matlab and Simulink 
 Write clean, well-structured code in Matlab and at least one of Python, Rust, Java or modern C++ 
 Report findings clearly, in writing and in person, to technical and non-technical audiences 
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.
 Nice to have
 Have applied system identification, control systems design or applied aerodynamics in a flight programme 
 Have deployed dynamics models onto real-time test rigs, such as hardware-in-the-loop setups 
 What We Offer
 Competitive salary and VSOP options 
 Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation 
 Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance 
 Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health) 
 Social: regular company events and monthly social allowances 
 Enhanced parental leave: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers 
 Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work 
 These are the core benefits across all locations; there may be additional benefits in specific sites.
Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

About Us 
 Lupa is building a category defining product the industry has never seen before.
 We are the AI-native operating system for veterinary practices and pet parents, replacing the fragmented, clunky systems vets have tolerated for years with a single intelligent platform for scheduling, client communication, clinical documentation, and AI-driven care guidance. Practices run more efficiently, vets get back to doing what they love, and pet parents feel more connected to their animals health than ever.
 The traction speaks for itself: one of Europe's top 100 AI startups with a team of over 80 people, 10x growth in twelve months, the UK market leader, and now charging hard into the US and Europe. We have $25M in funding, 3M+ pets on the platform, and a buzzing HQ in Paddington, London.
 AI is not a side project here. Jerry, our AI teammate for vets, launches this month with clinical decision support, a listening mode for live consults, and hands-free voice next. You will ship weekly to real clinics and see the impact directly.
 In this role, you will: 
 Build Jerry's clinical guideline library: RAG over vet-approved guidelines using hybrid vector and keyword search in Postgres, so Jerry answers clinical questions only from approved sources and cites the exact lines it used
 Build Jerry's listening mode: a fast classifier that watches live consult transcripts and triggers Jerry to surface missed charges, tests, or risks in real time
 Build Jerry's voice mode: a hands-free, voice-first experience for ambulatory vets on the road, where everything is spoken and any change waits for the vet's approval
 Build long-running and scheduled Jerry tasks: turns that keep running after the vet closes the tab, and scheduled jobs that prepare drafts for the vet to approve
 Own what you build in production across the TypeScript server and Python AI service: deploys, monitoring, fixes, weekly releases, and a share of on-call
 Be a trusted reviewer on AI pull requests and write the design docs for new AI features
 Your background looks something like: 
 4+ years of professional software engineering, including at least a year shipping LLM features to real users in production
 TypeScript in production (Node.js backend and React) and Python in production (FastAPI or similar)
 Has built with LLM APIs in production: tool calling and agent loops, structured output, prompt and model iteration
 Deploys and owns code in production: CI/CD, Docker, a cloud platform (AWS ideally), monitoring and fixing live issues
 SQL and Postgres, with git fluency across branches, rebasing, pull requests, and code review
 RAG experience: embeddings, hybrid vector and keyword search (pgvector), reranking, citations (nice to have · the first project)
 Voice AI experience: real-time voice agents, speech-to-text, telephony integration (nice to have)
 Works well with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) and reviews their output critically
 As a person, you: 
 Are a product engineer first · you care about what ships and how it performs in front of real users, not just whether it works in a test environment
 Own your code end to end, from design doc to production, and do not consider a feature done until it is monitored and stable
 Can explain the code you wrote, including the code your AI tools wrote for you
 Are comfortable in a small team with a big scope, working directly alongside vets, product, and the wider engineering org
 Are excited to work from our London WeWork office most of the week
 Value working with people who are kind, ambitious, and pragmatic
 What does success look like in 6 months? 
 Shipping to production every week and contributing to on-call
 Jerry's guideline library v1 is live for pilot clinics: it answers only from approved guidelines, cites exact lines, and passes the clinical team's test questions
 Listening mode is piloted with at least one clinic, with every suggestion tracked to show the revenue it recovers
 Long-running and scheduled tasks are in production and a voice-first Jerry has been tested with an ambulatory clinic

Für unseren Kunden, ein innovatives Technologieunternehmen im Bereich der Entwicklung und Fertigung anspruchsvoller mechatronischer Systeme, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Embedded Softwareentwickler (m/w/d).
 Unser Kunde entwickelt leistungsstarke Energie- und Antriebssysteme für sicherheitskritische Anwendungen in den Bereichen Luftfahrt, Sicherheit und Verteidigung sowie Bahntechnik. In einem interdisziplinären Entwicklungsumfeld erwarten Sie vielseitige technische Herausforderungen, innovative Projekte und die Möglichkeit, die Entwicklung komplexer Embedded-Systeme aktiv mitzugestalten.

Ab sofort bzw. zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt

 - Analyse und Umsetzung technischer Anforderungen auf Basis von Datenblättern und Spezifikationen

 - Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Softwareentwicklung

 - Erfahrung mit harten Echtzeitsystemen und Echtzeitbetriebssystemen, beispielsweise FreeRTOS
 - Kenntnisse strukturierter Entwicklungsprozesse, beispielsweise nach dem V-Modell

Die Fahrbarkeit unserer Fahrzeuge entsteht im Zusammenspiel von Antrieb, Fahrstrategie, Software und Fahrzeug. Als Entwicklungsingenieur für Driveability gestaltest du dieses Zusammenspiel aktiv mit. Du entwickelst und optimierst Funktionen für elektrische und konventionelle Antriebssysteme und begleitest sie von der funktionalen Idee bis zur Erprobung im Fahrzeug.

- Du entwickelst und optimierst Funktionen und Strategien zur Verbesserung der Fahrbarkeit unserer Nutzfahrzeuge
- Du entwickelst Funktionskonzepte für Antriebssysteme und begleitest diese von der Anforderung über die Implementierung bis zur Inbetriebnahme und Absicherung im Fahrzeug
- Du analysierst das Zusammenspiel von Antrieb, Getriebe, Schaltstrategie und Fahrzeug und leitest daraus Verbesserungen für Fahrkomfort und Fahrverhalten ab

- Du arbeitest eng mit anderen Funktionen und Entwicklungsteams zusammen und stimmst funktionale Anforderungen mit den relevanten Stakeholdern ab
- Du bringst deine Ergebnisse in ein globales und markenübergreifendes Entwicklungsumfeld innerhalb der TRATON GROUP ein

- Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Fahrzeugtechnik, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Du besitzt ein gutes Verständnis von Fahrzeugdynamik, Antriebsstrang und Fahrbarkeit
- Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung in der Entwicklung oder Applikation von Antriebs- und Getriebefunktionen bzw. Schaltstrategien mit
- Du hast Freude daran, Software- und Funktionsentwicklung nicht nur am Schreibtisch zu betreiben, sondern ihre Wirkung direkt im Fahrzeug zu analysieren und zu optimieren
- Erfahrungen mit modellbasierter Entwicklung, Simulation und Fahrzeugmesstechnik sind von Vorteil
- Du arbeitest analytisch, eigenverantwortlich und lösungsorientiert und bringst gleichzeitig Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Teams mit
- Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir die Zusammenarbeit in unserem internationalen Entwicklungsumfeld

- Globale Karrierechancen bei TRATON-Marken in Schweden, USA und Brasilien

About us
 We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.
 Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.
 We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.
 Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.
 Your mission
 As a Junior Mechanical Engineer, you enter as a member of the early team building the physical body of our humanoid - an industrial-grade machine built for the highest levels of reliability and performance. You will work directly with our senior engineers to turn concepts into detailed CAD, back them up with calculations and simulation, and get parts built and tested. You learn fast, and you take pride in getting the basics right from day one.
 Your profile
 Key responsibilities 
 Detailed Design & CAD: Build and maintain CAD models, assemblies and production drawings from senior engineers' concepts - structural parts, brackets, housings and actuator components.
 Engineering Calculations: Carry out bearing, fastener and strength calculations, document your assumptions clearly and review them with the team.
 Simulation Support: Set up and run FEA studies (static, modal, thermal) and prepare the results for design reviews.
 Prototyping & Testing: Prepare parts for manufacture (drawings, tolerances, BOMs), coordinate with the workshop and suppliers, and assemble and test prototypes - feeding what you learn straight back into the design.
 DFM/DFA in Practice: Apply the team's DFM/DFA standards in your daily work and flag manufacturing or assembly issues early.
 Documentation: Keep CAD data, BOMs, release status and design notes clean and up to date so the team can move fast.
 Cross-Functional Support: Work with the AI, Controls and Software teams on integration details such as sensor mounts, cable routing and mass properties.
 Who we are looking for 
We seek builders ready to move beyond demos to real-world deployment - early-career engineers who value precision and reliability as much as innovation.
 Experience:  2+ years of professional experience and a degree (BSc/MSc) in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, aerospace or a related field. Internships, working student roles, a hardware-focused thesis or student teams (e.g. Formula Student, robotics competitions) count.
 Core Skills: Solid 3D CAD skills including clean production drawings and GD&T basics, and a strong grounding in machine elements and strength of materials (bearings, fasteners, stress analysis, load paths). Also expected:  
 First hands-on FEA experience and the habit of sanity-checking results by hand.  
 Working knowledge of common manufacturing processes (CNC machining, sheet metal, additive manufacturing, injection moulding) and how they shape a design. 
 Comfortable in the workshop - assembling prototypes, measuring parts, 3D printing and basic machining.  
 A basic understanding of kinematics and actuators is a plus.
 Mindset:  You balance the agility of a startup with the professional rigor required for a global industrial player. You are curious, take feedback well and own your work end to end - and you understand that a robot in the real world faces forces and failures that don't exist in a simulation.
 Why us?
 The Team : Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.
 Smart Strategy : We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.
 Resources : We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.
 Historic Opportunity : Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.
 We are an equal opportunity employer.

items.jobTitle: Embedded Software Engineer C++ (m/w/d) Hardware and Embedded Linux
items.jobDescription:
Bei Rohde & Schwarz entwickeln wir am Standort Chemnitz innovative Software- und Systemlösungen für unsere Test- und Messtechnik. Gemeinsam mit unseren Teams aus Softwareentwicklung, Signalverarbeitung und Elektrotechnik gestalten wir leistungsfähige Messgeräte und Anwendungen, die unsere Kunden bei der Entwicklung und Analyse anspruchsvoller elektronischer Systeme unterstützen. Als Teil eines internationalen Technologieunternehmens mit über 16000 Mitarbeitenden arbeiten wir dabei standortübergreifend an Lösungen, die höchste Anforderungen an Präzision, Performance und Qualität erfüllen.
Aufgaben
 Du entwickelst moderne C++-Software zur Ansteuerung und Integration eigener Hardwarebaugruppen auf Embedded-Linux-Systemen, einschließlich Hardware-Abstraktionsschichten und gerätespezifischer Komponenten.
 Du nimmst Hardware auf Board- und Systemebene in Betrieb, analysierst und behebst Fehler und verifizierst die Funktion mithilfe von JTAG, Debuggern, Logging und messtechnischen Aufbauten.
 Du entwickelst Embedded Firmware für Mikrocontroller in Bare-Metal- und RTOS-Umgebungen und implementierst Schnittstellen zu verschiedenen Hardware-Peripherien.
 Du konzipierst und implementierst gerätenahe Funktionalitäten und stellst eine klare Trennung zwischen hardwarenaher Software, Low-Level-Ansteuerung und Applikationslogik sicher.
 Du definierst und implementierst Schnittstellen zwischen Software, Firmware, FPGA und Hardware, beispielsweise Register Maps, Kommunikationsschnittstellen und Datenformate.
 Du entwickelst Test- und Diagnosewerkzeuge sowie automatisierte Unit- und Integrationstests für Verifikation, Validierung und Laborabläufe.
 Du analysierst und optimierst Performance, Stabilität und Ressourcennutzung hardwarenaher Softwarekomponenten.
 Du setzt Shift-Left-Prinzipien um, indem du Tests, Simulationen, statische Codeanalysen und automatisierte Checks frühzeitig in den Entwicklungsprozess integrierst.
 Du nutzt KI-gestützte Entwicklungstools für Prototyping, Testgenerierung und wiederkehrende Entwicklungsaufgaben und stellst durch etablierte Review- und Testprozesse die Qualität der Ergebnisse sicher.
 Du arbeitest eng mit interdisziplinären Teams aus Software-, FPGA-, Hardware- und Testentwicklung zusammen und dokumentierst Anforderungen, technische Konzepte und Verifikationsergebnisse.
 Qualifikationen
 Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik, Nachrichtentechnik, Informationstechnik, Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung.
 Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Embedded-Softwareentwicklung und sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in modernem C++.
 Du bringst praktische Erfahrung mit Embedded Linux und hardwarenaher Softwareentwicklung mit, idealerweise in den Bereichen Hardware Abstraction Layer, Gerätetreiber oder Board-Level-Integration.
 Du bist mit Mikrocontrollern und gängigen Hardwareschnittstellen wie SPI, I²C, UART, GPIO, ADC/DAC oder Ethernet vertraut.
 Du hast Erfahrung mit Hardware-Inbetriebnahme und Debugging und arbeitest sicher mit Debuggern sowie messtechnischer Laborausrüstung wie Oszilloskopen oder Spektrumanalysatoren.
 Du bist mit modernen Softwareentwicklungsprozessen und Werkzeugen wie Git, Code Reviews, automatisierten Tests und CI/CD vertraut.
 Kenntnisse in CMake, Yocto, BSP-Entwicklung, Bootloadern wie U-Boot oder der Konfiguration des Linux-Kernels sind von Vorteil.
 Erfahrungen mit Bare-Metal- oder RTOS-basierter Firmwareentwicklung sowie mit Python oder MATLAB für Prototyping, Testautomatisierung oder Datenanalyse sind ebenfalls von Vorteil.
 Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen und modernen Shift-Left-Testansätzen.
 Du verfügst über ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und gehst bei Fehlersuche, Problemanalyse und Performanceoptimierung strukturiert vor.
 Du arbeitest gerne an der Schnittstelle zwischen Software und Hardware, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.
 Kontakt und weitere Informationen

About us
 We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.
 Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.
 We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.
 Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.
 Your mission
 The role
 As an AI Engineer for Simulation Environments, you enter as a key member of the early AI team. You will work directly with our AI leadership and researchers to define the simulated worlds in which our humanoid robots learn and are evaluated. You design training and evaluation environments with state-of-the-art physics engines, build and curate the asset libraries that fill them, and own the large-scale benchmarks that tell us - quickly and reliably - whether a new policy is better. Your environments sit between research, hardware and product, so how well they match reality and how useful they are directly sets how fast and how safely we can bring new capabilities to our robots. This is a full-time, permanent position.
 Your profile
 Key responsibilities 
 Training and Evaluation Environments: Design and build scalable simulation environments for humanoid robots with physics engines such as MjLab and Isaac Lab. Work with AI researchers to create challenging training tasks, curricula and evaluation scenarios.
 Asset Management: Build and curate our database of robot, object and scene assets - including import, validation, collision and physics properties, metadata and versioning - so that environments can be assembled quickly and reproducibly.
 Simulation Benchmarking: Own rigorous, large-scale simulation benchmarks and evaluation sweeps that enable fast policy evaluation cycles, with statistically sound metrics, regression tracking and clear reporting to research teams.
 Sim-to-Real Alignment: Work with hardware and control engineers to align simulation with reality through robot modeling, actuator and sensor models, system identification and validation against real-world data.
 Use-Case Driven Environments: Work with product teams to turn real customer use cases into simulated environments and benchmarks that measure what matters for deployment.
 Who we are looking for
 We seek people who embrace the empirical nature of AI research and want to accelerate our research velocity with best-in-class tools - so that we can all make breakthroughs faster, together.
 Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience building simulation environments for robot learning with physics engines such as MuJoCo/MjLab, MuJoCo Warp/MJX, Isaac Lab/Isaac Sim or Newton.
 Core Skills: Deep understanding of physics simulation and large-scale evaluation infrastructure. In detail:
 Simulation Physics: Rigid-body dynamics and contact simulation, including solver parameters, numerical stability and the trade-offs between simulation speed and fidelity.
 Assets & Formats: Robot and scene description formats and asset pipelines - URDF, MJCF, OpenUSD, mesh processing and convex decomposition (e.g. CoACD, V-HACD) - and asset validation at scale.
 Benchmarking Infrastructure: GPU-parallel simulation, sweep orchestration, reproducibility and statistically sound metrics.

Gesucht wird eine Ingenieur:in für Großwärmepumpen (m/w/d) zur Planung und Realisierung von Projekten sowie zur technischen Begleitung vor Ort. Our Mission
 At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.
 We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!
 The Role
 As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases.
 You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. The system has to work day and night, in challenging weather, across different embodiments and changing site conditions. We measure success by whether the robot completes its patrol on a live site, not by how it performs in simulation.
 What You'll Work On
 Navigation and path-planning design: how robots represent traversable space, select routes, avoid obstacles, and reach goals across complex sites.
 Sensor integration driven by navigation requirements, including what ground segmentation and traversability estimation need in day, night, and challenging weather.
 Environment understanding: how the robot distinguishes ground from obstacles and estimates which terrain is safe and practical to traverse.
 Behavior prediction: anticipate how people, vehicles, and other dynamic obstacles will move, and plan routes that stay safe and efficient around them.
 Field reliability: reproduce failures from deployments, find the root cause, and fix it at the right layer, from sensor data and maps to costmaps, planners, and recovery behaviors.
 Planning under imperfect localization: plans that stay useful when the state estimate drifts and the robot must execute routes in tight or dynamic environments, working with the rest of Robot Autonomy on localization and control.
 Validation on real robots: logs, simulation, and repeatable field tests to verify that design choices and changes hold across routes, lighting, weather, and site layouts.
 New autonomy capabilities: work with the engineers building the operator application and backend so operator requests and new robot capabilities rest on a sound navigation design.
 The field feedback loop: work closely with forward-deployed engineers to turn site issues into bugs, design changes, and improvements to the navigation stack.
 Regular site visits to build a practical understanding of how robots and sensors behave in real operating conditions.
 Who We're Looking For
 We're looking for an engineer who has taken a robotics system from unreliable to dependable and takes ownership beyond individual tickets. You can explain why you made a navigation design choice and what it costs. When a robot takes a bad route, you can tell whether the planner, the map, the state estimate, or the robot's behavior is at fault, and you fix the right one. You are comfortable in the field and want to understand how robots behave in real customer environments.
 Your Background
 A Master's degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 Proven track record building and deploying navigation on ground mobile robots in the real world (3+ years or equivalent depth).
 Hands-on experience with mobile robot navigation and path planning: route or local planning, static and dynamic obstacle avoidance, costmaps, or recovery behaviors.
 Understanding of how mapping and localization affect navigation, and the ability to diagnose when a planning issue is actually caused by the map, the state estimate, or robot behavior.
 Understanding of how lighting, weather, terrain, and sensor limitations affect perception and navigation, with experience developing or validating systems for demanding real-world conditions.
 Hands-on experience with robotics sensors and hardware, especially LiDAR, IMUs, and cameras. You can investigate issues across software, networking, and hardware boundaries.
 Experience testing and debugging navigation on physical robots using logs, visualization, simulation, and repeatable field tests.
 Strong ROS 2, C++, and Python skills.
 Clear communication of navigation and path-planning design choices and their trade-offs.
 Willingness to visit customer sites regularly.
 Nice to Have
 Experience with legged robots or with more than one robot embodiment.
 Experience with Nav2 or a comparable navigation framework.
 Motion prediction or planning among people and vehicles, such as trajectory forecasting or socially aware navigation.
 Terrain mapping and traversability methods: elevation mapping, learned traversability, or semantic segmentation for navigation.
 Experience with night-time or all-weather sensing, such as thermal cameras or LiDAR in rain and fog.
 Background in security, defence, or other safety-critical robotics deployments.
 What We Offer
 Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.
 Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.
 Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.
 Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.
 Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package
 Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

Who We Are
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
 The role
 As a Stress and Dynamics Engineer at Helsing, you will own the structural integrity of our drone systems, from full vehicle assemblies down to critical components. Working at the intersection of advanced simulation and physical testing, you will define loads, build and validate finite element models, and deliver structural assessments that directly inform design decisions. Your work underpins the airworthiness and performance of autonomous systems operating in demanding environments. You will collaborate closely with mechanical design, systems, and test teams, translating complex physical behaviour into clear engineering judgements that accelerate development and reduce technical risk.
 The day-to-day
 Own the end-to-end structural simulation of complex drone products, major subassemblies, and critical components, delivering assessments that directly gate design decisions 
 Define and derive loads, boundary conditions, and material properties, ensuring simulation inputs are physically grounded and fully traceable to system requirements 
 Perform static and dynamic structural assessments, including modal analyses and model correlation tasks, to validate structural integrity across the full flight envelope 
 Plan and execute structural tests for model validation and technology derisking, translating test data into actionable design guidance 
 Produce comprehensive design reports and sensitivity studies that identify optimal structural solutions, in line with company quality standards and engineering guidelines 
 You should apply if you
 Have built, validated, and correlated finite element models of complex aerospace or equivalently demanding structures using tools such as Simcenter or SolidWorks Simulation 
 Can analytically assess standard structural components (bolts, bearings, fittings) and apply relevant engineering standards with confidence and rigour 
 Have planned and executed structural test campaigns and can close the loop between test data and simulation through systematic model correlation 
 Are proficient in calculation environments such as MATLAB/Simulink and can apply model order reduction methods to simplify high-fidelity structural systems 
 Communicate technical findings clearly in written reports and cross-functional discussions, in English, to both engineering and non-engineering audiences 
 Act decisively with minimal guidance, own outcomes end-to-end and initiate solutions without waiting for direction 
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.
 Nice to Have
 Experience with drone or UAV structural design, including familiarity with the specific load cases and certification considerations of unmanned systems 
 Proficiency in CAD tools for structural simplification and model preparation as part of an integrated mechanical design workflow 
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world

About Alta Ares
Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.
 Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
 Founded in 2024, we have grown to 160 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.
 Role & Mission
 Turn radar sensing requirements into FPGA designs that support reliable drone detection in operational conditions.
 Define how radar data is acquired, processed, and delivered to the rest of the system, working across RF, electronics, and software teams.
 Establish processing budgets and select implementation approaches based on detection performance, latency, numerical accuracy, and available FPGA resources.
 Develop reference models to study radar behavior in noise and clutter and guide hardware design decisions.
 Build reusable RTL functions for waveform generation and receive processing in FMCW and pulsed radar systems.
 Implement the processing stages needed to extract targets from radar returns, including matched filtering, pulse compression, range-Doppler processing, clutter rejection, and CFAR detection.
 Integrate ADC/DAC interfaces, coordinate transmit and receive timing, and ensure synchronization with the radar front end.
 Specify how detections and associated measurements are passed to tracking functions and embedded software.
 Verify designs against reference models through automated testbenches and hardware-in-the-loop testing.
 Investigate performance gaps on target hardware and use laboratory measurements and field results to improve the processing chain.
 Document design decisions, interfaces, and validation results to support integration and future product development.
Candidate Profile
 At least three years of FPGA development experience, with practical exposure to radar or sonar processing.
 Ability to take a signal-processing function from an algorithmic description to verified RTL in VHDL or Verilog/SystemVerilog.
 Strong DSP foundations, including FFT, digital filtering, windowing, and the effects of quantization and fixed-point precision.
 Understanding of how radar systems estimate target range and velocity, distinguish returns from clutter, and set detection thresholds.
 Working knowledge of matched filtering, pulse compression, range-Doppler maps, and CFAR techniques.
 Familiarity with FMCW and pulsed radar, including the relationship between waveform choices, acquisition timing, and digital processing.
 Experience assessing radar performance through simulation, including signal-to-noise ratio and clutter effects.
 Experience developing testbenches, debugging FPGA hardware, and validating processing chains with hardware-in-the-loop methods.
 Master’s degree or equivalent in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Applied Physics, or a related field.
 Skills & Qualities
 Hands-on engineer motivated by making radar processing work reliably on physical hardware.
 Able to connect system-level performance issues with their causes in algorithms, RTL, interfaces, or timing.
 Methodical approach to debugging, verification, and documenting technical decisions.
 Comfortable owning development tasks and coordinating integration work across disciplines.
 Clear communicator who makes trade-offs explicit and flags risks early.
 Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-growing company.
 High integrity and professionalism in handling sensitive defense technologies.
 Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Who We Are
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing program managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
 The role
 Imagine building the vital infrastructure for a cutting-edge autonomous aerial platform that will actually take flight. At Helsing, you won't just be developing software; you'll be shaping the foundational capabilities for our own Unmanned Combat Aerial Vehicle (UCAV), the CA-1 Europa. This is a unique opportunity to directly contribute to a novel system designed from the ground up.
You will be building the higher-level mission control foundation, the sophisticated infrastructure that enables real-time sensor processing, secure communication, seamless integration of autonomous decision-making modules, and reliable interfacing with lower-level flight control systems. This isn't theoretical; your code will be critical to the CA-1 Europa's ability to fly, perceive, and operate effectively in the most demanding environments.
We build software that is subject to significant and unorthodox technical constraints, must operate in a wide variety of constantly-changing environments, and has to support an ever-growing list of challenging use-cases. What we build ultimately ends up in the hands of real people in high-risk, high-stress situations, so it must be both reliable and frictionless. Taken together, this brings a whole host of interesting engineering challenges across a wide variety of fields that you’ll help us solve. To give some examples:
 Distributed systems & Communications (e.g., intermittent connectivity and integrating with bespoke communication hardware and protocols) 
 Embedded computing (e.g., resource-constrained compute and real-time operating systems) 
 Networking (e.g., long-range low-bandwidth radios and cross-medium routing) 
 Deployment & Integration Infrastructure (e.g., designing and implementing custom secure runtime environments for vendor code) 
 In several of these areas, we are working near the state-of-the-art; we actively read (and sometimes implement) research papers, and often need to push even further to make theory work in practice. In others, we are applying well-known techniques to real-world situations (with real-world limitations) that have never been used in before, which requires skill, diligence, and honing a deep understanding of the underlying technologies.
 The day-to-day
 Review code contributions, proposals, and RFCs from colleagues, ensuring robustness and adherence to safety and performance standards critical for airborne applications. At Helsing we strongly believe that unblocking others takes precedence over spending more time on your own work. 
 Propose and implement new features, capabilities, algorithms, infrastructure, or even full products across our stack, with a focus on refining the capabilities and reliability of our airborne mission systems. We encourage our engineers to look beyond their immediate team for missed opportunities, and to speak up when they identify one. 
 Become a mentor, find a mentee, and help support and develop our interviewing pipeline. The people make or break the company, and we want as many engineers as possible to be part of fostering and growing the organisation. 
 Share your experience and technical know-how with other Helsingers. We host tech talks, get together for smaller “let’s learn together” groups, run topical office hours (e.g., on Rust), etc. to help each other get better with time. 
 Maintain our existing software stack, including working with internal and external customers to identify issues, improving operational reliability and performance, and fending off technical debt. The stack is a mix of Rust and Python, with Python mainly living in the ML-heavy sections. 
 Further develop our tests and benchmarks, both at the micro and macro level, including hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulations and flight testing. We operate in a domain where robustness is of the utmost importance, and an extensive and ever-improving test suite is key to achieving that. And without thorough benchmarks, we would be flying blind. 
 Present your work at our weekly demo sessions. We want engineers to come together around what they are working on and to feel like they are not endlessly squirreling away at something that doesn’t matter. To that end, we host (and actively work towards) demo sessions that allow early feedback, celebration of progress, and a better shared understanding of everything that goes on at Helsing. 
 You should apply if you
 Can write legible, maintainable, and performant code. 
 Communicate well in English, both verbally and in writing. 
 Enjoy collaborating with others, including reviewing code and pair programming, particularly on complex system architectures involving tight hardware-software integration on a real-world aerial platform. 
 Are comfortable working asynchronously (writing PRs and RFCs, having discussions by email). 
 Have strong backend or embedded development experience, ideally with a language like Rust, Go, or C++. 
 Feel comfortable developing distributed systems. 
 Strive to improve yourself, your peers, and the culture you work in over time. 
 Feel like ethical considerations are an inherent part of engineering. 
 Note: We o perate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-re presented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.
 Nice to have
 Significant experience with Rust. 
 Network programming experience. 
 Experience designing or implementing custom runtime environments, sandboxing, or secure execution contexts for third-party code. 
 Experience with avionics, flight control systems, or Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC). 
 Familiarity with low-level flight control systems and their interfaces, even if not directly developing them. 
 Experience with sensor integration (IMUs, GPS, Lidar, Cameras) and sensor fusion techniques for navigation. 
 Hardware interfaces (e.g., Arduino). 
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns. 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world. 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward. 
 In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts. 
 We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about. 
 What We Offer
 A focus on outcomes, not time-tracking 
 Competitive compensation and VSOP options 
 Relocation support 
 Social and education allowances 
 Regular company events and all-hands to bring together employees as one team across Europe

items.jobDescription:
Das Teilinstitut Dresden des Fraunhofer-Instituts für Fertigungstechnik und Angewandte Materialforschung IFAM mit derzeit ca. 120 Mitarbeitenden ist spezialisiert auf die Grundlagen- und Anwendungsforschung zur lösungsorientierten Werkstoff- und Technologieentwicklung für innovative Sinter- und Verbundwerkstoffe, Funktionswerkstoffe sowie zellulare metallische Werkstoffe für die Energietechnik, Mobilität und Medizintechnik. In der Energietechnik kommt der Wasserstofftechnologie eine tragende Rolle zu. Sind Sie bald mit dabei?
 Hier sorgen Sie für Veränderung 
 Im Rahmen eines Projekts zur Entwicklung von innovativer Wasserstoffspeichermaterialien werden Sie sich aktiv an der experimentellen Weiterentwicklung der POWERPASTE-Technologie beteiligen. Dabei unterstützen Sie mit verschiedenen Aufgaben wie der Literaturrecherche und Methodenentwicklung zur in-situ-Messung der Viskosität von repräsentativen Reaktionsslurrys in gerührten Systemen. Darüber hinaus gehören die Erstellung von Versuchsplänen, die Durchführung von Experimenten sowie die Datenanalyse, -auswertung und Dokumentation zu Ihren Aufgaben.
 Hiermit bringen Sie sich ein 
 Sie studieren Energie-, Prozess-, Verfahrenstechnik, Maschinenbau, Chemieingenieurwesen oder Chemie mit Schwerpunkt Technische Chemie / chemische Verfahrenstechnik und haben Interesse an dem aufgezeigten, interessanten Aufgabengebiet? Dann bewerben Sie sich bei uns! 
 Was wir für Sie bereithalten 
 die Chance, als Teil eines starken Teams eigene Ideen einzubringen und Lösungen für drängende Zukunftsfragen zu finden,
 flexible Zeiteinteilung,
 engagierte und fachkundige Betreuung,
 die Möglichkeit, verschiedenste Studienarbeiten (Praktikumsarbeit) zu verfassen. 
 Die Vergütung richtet sich nach der Gesamtbetriebsvereinbarung zur Beschäftigung der Hilfskräfte (je nach Qualifikation). Die Stelle ist befristet und die Arbeitszeit kann im Vorfeld flexibel abgesprochen werden. 
 Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt. Unsere Aufgaben sind vielfältig und anpassbar – für Bewerber*innen mit Behinderung finden wir gemeinsam Lösungen, die ihre Fähigkeiten optimal fördern. 
 Mit ihrer Fokussierung auf zukunftsrelevante Schlüsseltechnologien sowie auf die Verwertung der Ergebnisse in Wirtschaft und Industrie spielt die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft eine zentrale Rolle im Innovationsprozess. Als Wegweiser und Impulsgeber für innovative Entwicklungen und wissenschaftliche Exzellenz wirkt sie mit an der Gestaltung unserer Gesellschaft und unserer Zukunft.  
 Bereit für Veränderung? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt, und machen Sie einen Unterschied! Nach Eingang Ihrer vollständigen Online-Bewerbung erhalten Sie eine automatische Empfangsbestätigung. Dann melden wir uns schnellstmöglich und sagen Ihnen, wie es weitergeht.
